text_block_list.text: One day, as autumn deepened its colors—

...Ever since Tanino Gimlet's debut race, 
I had been spending my free time 
researching and studying the Umamusume of 
her generation.

Amidst all this, today I'm watching a mock 
race to see a "certain Umamusume" run...

"Entering the final stretch bunched up 
from first to last. As every Umamusume 
unleashed their fiery drive for victory—"

text_block_list.name: Racing Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Yaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Racing Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Uwoooooah!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――――Target in sight.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Haaah—!

Straight and merciless as a fired bullet, 
a jet-black flash overtaking everyone 
running ahead—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
choice_data_list: (I really can't take my eyes off her...)
(I really can't take my eyes off her.)

text_block_list.text: —Symboli Kris S.

A fellow member of Tanino Gimlet's 
generation, she exuded a cold, commanding 
presence both during and after the race...

As an international exchange student, her 
composure stood out distinctly even in her 
debut race.

Of course, if it were just about being a 
calm and composed Umamusume, there are 
plenty of others. However, Symboli Kris S 
is—

In the interview after her debut race, she 
declared it boldly: "I came to Japan to 
bring about a 'revolution' in the racing 
world."

Even when speaking of such a grand goal, 
she showed neither fear nor tension, 
remaining entirely composed and serene...

"The sheer depth of her 'unyielding' 
resolve... felt on par with that of Tanino 
Gimlet—"

"And right now, Symboli Kris S is steadily 
sharpening her running edge. Which means 
going forward—"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—Yes, the one we must be most wary of is 
him.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"You felt it too, didn't you? The waves of 
Kris S's stern, frigid soul."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Even from my perspective, she is 
extraordinary.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
An unbreakable resolve and an unwavering 
stride. The absolute presence born from 
them resembles the sheer ruthlessness of 
harsh nature.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Just imagining that line of fire aimed at 
me— Heh heh, how utterly terrifying, yet 
delightful...!
choice_data_list:
Looks like you're pretty conscious of it 
too, huh?

You're paying pretty close attention to it 
too, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
......You're right. I ought to make this 
clear to you.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
That she, too— is someone who makes me 
feel the pull of destiny.

The memory brought forth by those words 
was of the feelings Tanino Gimlet had 
briefly shown before—

It was the same look she had when she 
revealed feeling something fateful about 
Vodka.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Whether it is "now" or "later," I do not 
know.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
However, one day, without fail... She will 
stand in my way. As a formidable opponent 
to enrich the narrative.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"You too should continue to observe her 
closely. All to ensure our scenario 
becomes absolute."

"And so, Tanino Gimlet and I shared our 
wariness of Symboli Kris S—"

—After that, one thing led to another, and 
I ended up having Tanino Gimlet look over 
the survey notes I'd compiled on our 
generation of Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh. To compile such extensive 
research records in the time leading up to 
today... Quite mad, indeed...!

Eyeing the completion of the MC rotation, 
I feel that even this isn't enough to walk 
alongside Tanino Gimlet, who pushes 
forward "swiftly" and "powerfully".

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh— You seem starved. Such greed... how 
truly sinful...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
To celebrate the sprouting of madness, I 
shall present mine as well. Captured by my 
Evil Eye: the soul waves and running of 
those who race through the same era!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"With this, we shall fortify our 
investigative records even further. As if 
compiling a forbidden tome...!"

Afterward, by adding new info on her 
generation of Umamusume from Tanino 
Gimlet's perspective, I was able to 
improve the accuracy of our data even 
further.

Realizing her diligence in researching 
thoroughly behind the scenes made me brace 
myself with renewed resolve once again—
—The next day.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: —"What is destiny?"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"To carry your soul to the most fitting 
place"—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"...Then were they carrying me? Or you? Or 
perhaps both of us?"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —...Gimlet.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Good morning, Kris S. My, my, what a 
splendid morning sun, and what a splendid 
coincidence.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Ah...— To think that you—would be here—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh. For all that, you don't look 
surprised in the slightest.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Or did you, too, sense it? That I would be 
here, at this very moment today.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"...It is a coincidence. —A walk. 
...Nothing more than a stroll."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh. If you're unaware, then that only 
makes it all the more intriguing...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—Your debut race the other day was 
magnificent. Including what you said 
afterward.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Bringing a "revolution" to the Japanese 
racing world. ...Ah, what a truly sweet 
sound that is!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Just how much "strength" will you show in 
order to accomplish that...! Heh heh. Just 
imagining it makes my heart race...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: "...With you— I cannot avoid... fighting."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...I believe that—she will appear— as a 
formidable rival—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. It is the same for me. The chains 
of fate shall never release us.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
No matter how the stars align, or how many 
worlds overlap—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
You and I will inevitably tear each other 
apart. That is our script.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Are you prepared, Kris S? There is no 
turning back now. The gears of time have 
already begun to move!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――……The die is cast.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Yes, let us begin. In this world, the 
battle chronicle where our paths 
cross...!"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Sharpen your fangs until that day comes. 
O jet-black, immovable warrior—"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...I will... do what must be done.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —That's all there is to it.

Each of their times now begins to move 
forward—
